svg.title: Payback includes a chance of never paying back

cc:Work.dc:title: Payback includes a chance of never paying back
cc:Work.dc:description: SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL • Unconditional first-payback CDF • Finite policy ends at day 425 The CDF is not renormalized among eventual successes: its terminal height is 1 − P(never under this policy). First payback can later be reversed by costs or revisions; it is distinct from being profitable at day 180 or staying profitable. “Never” means no crossing through the finite policy endpoint, not an infinite-lifetime claim. 0%/100% draw estimates are not certainty.
